verdict.rationale: Smooth is API-first. Its REST API covers running tasks, interactive sessions with goto, extract, evaluate_js and close events, custom tools, structured output, proxies, and listing and cancelling tasks, so most core operations are programmatic. However, nothing documents parity with the UI. Some flows appear human/UI-oriented: profiles rely on a manual login, and the live view supports human takeover. No OpenAPI spec was found to confirm surface completeness. Missing for 10: an explicit API/UI parity statement, API coverage of account/profile/key management, a machine-readable API spec, and independent corroboration.
